about: The apps of the Korean screen archive, in the order they are walked. `reference` is the catalog id of the same service's DESIGN.md, so a sheet and an item page can point at each other. `core` routes are where the eleven core screens of taxonomy.json are expected; they are guesses until the first walk confirms them, and the first walk rewrites them. `private` lists screens that are looked at without --walk first and kept only with --private or --cover. `never` lists what is not tapped. Bundle ids are from the App Store's public lookup (country kr), 2026-11-14. Whether an app is installed on the phone is not known from here.

core_route.온보딩: first launch after install only (owner present); otherwise absent
core_route.로그인: signed out: the app's own log-in entry, usually from 마이. The sign-in options on this screen say whether a demo account works
core_route.홈: first screen after launch and settle; then `pages --count 4` for what is below
core_route.검색: the search field or magnifier on home; a screen already seen may be reached with `go`
core_route.검색 결과: type a plain product word of the app's own category, submit from the keyboard
core_route.목록: a category, ranking or sale tab from home
core_route.상세: the first item of a list; then `pages --count 4`
core_route.알림: the bell on home or 마이: look without --walk first
core_route.마이: the last bottom tab: look without --walk first, keep with --private
core_route.팝업: whatever opens on launch is recorded by `settle --walk` before it is closed
